name: template-library-loader
body: Template library loader: reads the project's `templates/` via an fs.FS rooted at it, validates it fail-fast in the templates-dir-validation order (library.yaml; layout — only library.yaml, slides/, sections/, themes/, media/ at top level; per template in `slides/<name>/` and `sections/<name>/`: required files, `template.yaml` well-formed with no `usage:` key, layout parses as standard html/template with the registry's function map, errors file:line-qualified; themes have theme.css; references — theme.css relative url() inside its theme dir, layout src/href inside templates/, and every layout `media "path"` argument relative (no absolute, no `..`) and existing under `templates/media/`, violations file:line-qualified to the layout), assigns each template its kind from its directory, parses each `template.yaml` into the template schema model and registers templates (template-registry) and themes (theme-registry); returns the first templates error path-qualified. Single source for start, templates, gallery and reload.
